issue.title: ASan memory leak in test_gc with --enable-experimental-jit (allocate_executor)

labels.name: type-bug
labels.description: An unexpected behavior, bug, or error

issue.body:
# Bug report

### Bug description:

I encountered a memory leak detection by AddressSanitizer when running `test_gc` with the experimental JIT enabled.

### Build reproduction

```bash
CC=clang-21 CXX=clang++-21 ./configure --with-pydebug --with-address-sanitizer --enable-experimental-jit=yes && make -j
```

### Test execution

```bash
./python -X dev -m test test_gc -j8 -uall
```
